nora: Heads up — we need to lock the capacity thresholds + feedback ownership for the DP pilot starting May. Goal: reliable signals without overloading eng. Quick ask: who owns weekly synthesis and what are the hard launch/rollback gates?
sam: +1. I can own synthesis for the first 6 weeks if we agree on format (summary + top 3 action items).
elaine: thanks. we should define capacity in three dims: partner slots, weekly active sessions, and async feedback backlog. propose: 20 partner slots, 10 active sessions/week, 50 open async issues max.
mike: that seems reasonable. how do we measure signal quality? we need an eval rubric (quant + qual).
jen: suggested rubric: 1) % of partners who hit the onboarding checklist (qual), 2) median time-to-first-successful-call (quant), 3) NPS or task completion for sample flows (qual).
nora: love it. can we make actionable SLOs? e.g., onboarding checklist adoption >= 80%, median ttfhc <= 3 days, weekly qualitative issues >= 5 with concrete repro.
sam: agree. for rollback gates: if onboarding adoption < 60% OR median ttfhc > 7 days for 2 consecutive weeks OR >30% of sessions are blocked by infra issues, we pause and revert to hosted defaults.
mike: infra gate makes sense. add a low-severity degradation policy too: if token latency > 2x baseline for 3% of requests for a day, we throttle DPS traffic and notify.
jen: who is point for partner communication? propose that Product owns weekly recap + action items; Solutions Eng handles tech outreach and runbooks.
nora: ok team owners: Product (jen) weekly recap, Sam synthesis, SE (mike) tech outreach, Eng (elaine) capacity ops.
nora: operational details: we need a simple intake form for partners to declare expected QPS and sample prompts. put in Notion + webhook to #dp-intake.
sam: I'll draft the intake template. key fields: primary use-case, data sensitivity (PHI/PII flag), expected peak sessions, integration timeline, preferred contact.
mike: for PHI/PII we must flag Private deployment options + compliance playbook. add a checkbox for 'requires on-prem or VPC'.
jen: feedback cadence: 2 weekly touchpoints: 30-min sync + async survey. also run a short 10-min usability test after onboarding flow for first 5 partners.
nora: on eval ownership — Sam will compile weekly, Jen will score against rubric, I will escalate anything triggering rollback gates.
jen: can we add automated telemetry hooks into Redwood Console? e.g., per-partner token cost, p50/p95 latency, error-rate. That will make triage faster.
mike: yep. @deploy-bot can we schedule a small dashboard for DP pilot (per-partner lanes)?
deploy-bot: create_dashboard request received: "dp-pilot-overview". ETA 3 working days. :robot_face:
elaine: ops checklist for go/no-go: infra capacity validated, rollback playbook documented, intake live, dashboards created, 3 pilot dry-run sessions done.
sam: timeline: intake + dashboards by next Tue (1765015600), dry-run sessions mid-next-week, soft-launch 2 weeks after that.
nora: sounds good. I'll share the updated runbook and acceptance criteria doc after this thread. Thanks all :raised_hands:
